components: ESO SkyCalc flux_ael (upper-atmosphere emission lines: OH, O2, Na, OI, ...) + flux_arc (airglow residual continuum)
site: ESO Paranal; pwv=3.5 mm; msolflux=130 sfu; season=time=0; ecl_lon=135 / ecl_lat=90 deg; standard ESO aerosols; moon_earth_dist=1
note: Same SkyCalc request parameters as the committed natural-sky LUT; the components sum to it within float32. The app scales this part only (airglow slider); scattered starlight, zodiacal light and lower-atmosphere emission stay fixed.
source: ESO SkyCalc (Noll et al. 2012, A&A 543, A92; Jones et al. 2013, A&A 560, A91)
